title: 2030 — First partnership hulls networks graduate 100
definition: 2030 milestone on the Museum School Partnerships roadmap.
description:
First partnership hulls networks graduate 100,000 learners with curator teachers credentials employers trust.

What must be true first: the gallery classrooms results have to replicate outside the lab, partnership logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and curator teachers operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed gallery classrooms demonstrations, partnership logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting curator teachers uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Museum School Partnerships Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Museum School Partnerships: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Museum School Partnerships — schools embedded in museums.

Phase 1 — Prove (gallery classrooms): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (partnership logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (curator teachers): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (collection access): partnership hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and students-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
key_points: Four phases: Prove, Build, Operate, Compound.
Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
